title: refactor(ci): split workflows, upgrade Node->20, improve caching & release hygiene
author: Ava Chen
description: This PR refactors our GitHub Actions pipelines to split responsibilities (lint, test, release) into focused workflows, upgrades the Node.js runner to 20.x across build/test jobs, pins and updates common Actions, and improves cache keys/restore logic to reduce cold CI time. Motivation: long monolithic workflows made iterating on CI slow and increased flakiness. Splitting allows parallel, cache-friendly execution and smaller blast radius for failures. Changes include: new .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml (unit + matrix), release.yml (release automation and changelog generation), consolidation of reusable workflow templates in .github/workflows/templates/, bump node-version usage to 20, pin actions/* versions and add checksum-based cache keys for node_modules and pnpm-store. Includes hygiene fixes: remove deprecated actions, inline small scripts into a dedicated scripts/ci-utils, update README CI section. This is intended as a non-breaking infra change. Checklist: 1) Split workflows implemented. 2) Node 20 bump applied to all JS/TS workflows. 3) Action versions pinned and vetted. 4) Cache keys improved and validated in CI. 5) Release workflow dry-run tested. 6) Docs updated. 7) Rollout plan documented in comment.

review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Please pin the actions/checkout and actions/setup-node versions instead of using 'v' to avoid accidental major updates. Also can we avoid using node 18 in the matrix now that we standardize on 20?
Ava Chen: Pinning done, added explicit sha for critical actions where available. Kept node 18 in the matrix for one more release cycle for compatibility testing per ENG-2043.
Sofia Patel: Release workflow looks good but add a dry-run guard to avoid accidental publishes during testing. Please ensure changelog generation uses repo token with correct scopes.
Ava Chen: Added dry-run condition and documented rollout steps. Release job only runs on release/* branch and needs manual approval for first run.
Marek Novak: Lint job cache hit was low in the first run — tightened key to include lockfile checksum and pnpm-store-version. Rerunning CI to validate.
Diego Ramirez: CI passed on rerun, approving.
Sofia Patel: Approving after dry-run validated and docs updated.
CI Bot: integration-tests failed on first run due to flaky e2e timeout, increased timeout and re-ran — passed.
Release Manager (comment): Coordinated manual dry-run on staging, no publish occurred, ready to merge.
release_notes: Refactor CI: split lint/test/release into separate workflows
Upgrade: Node.js runner bumped to 20.x for CI jobs
Caching: improved cache keys for faster CI on cold boots
Release: added dry-run guard and changelog automation for controlled releases
Repo hygiene: pinned GH Actions versions and removed deprecated workflows
summary: Refactor CI to improve speed, reliability, and release hygiene; bump Node to 20; pin actions and improve caching. Merged after approvals and CI green.
